result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate for convenience on 30 days' prior written notice, Vendor must refund prepaid Fees allocable to the post-termination period, and no early-termination charge applies. No convenience termination right is granted to Vendor during a committed term. The amendment is limited to adding the required right and renumbering the existing provision, while preserving the original cause-based termination rights and other commercial terms.
